info.description: 18 proposed internal operations, not a deployed API. Preserves v0.2 core and adds five feature-gated proposals. One Go platform-api, one Python cognition-api. Only metric/rule direct execution payloads are formalized. Public UI APIs are documented separately.

ReferenceValidationResponse.description: Receipt binds caller/tenant/references/revisions server-side; not a grant or a reservation. PASS requires every item VALID; validate again at execution.

ExecutionLookupResponse.description: NOT_FOUND alone never proves a request was not executed. True resubmit flag requires durable atomic idempotency admission and current authorization. terminal responses must match state and operation.
